title: Pathing Plus
description: Plan your route before you commit. Pin map nodes to compare the routes through them, see a table of what each route offers (elites, fires, chests...), and zoom out to view the whole map at once. Works with mouse or controller. Informational only.
changeNote: v0.10.1 - Pin rings no longer draw on nodes you could travel to right now: when travel is available, the game's own markers stay unambiguous and the pin's ring steps aside (the pin itself keeps filtering your routes). The ring returns if travel goes unavailable again.
